source.paper: Kouichi Yasui, Small exotic rational surfaces without 1- and 3-handles

conventions.component_orientation: arc labels increase cyclically, e.g. A1 -> A2 -> ... -> A18 -> A1
conventions.overstrand: the strand through Y and W, oriented by the component arc order
conventions.cyclic_order: X, Y, Z, W listed counterclockwise around the crossing
conventions.sign_status: derived by a provisional local cyclic-order convention in the sanity script; this convention is not yet calibrated against a standard positive crossing diagram

self_twists.status: must be expanded before evaluator use
self_twists.expected_expansion: split the local A15 segment into subarcs such as A15a, A15b, A15c and add the two self-crossings of a positive full twist

sanity_observation.interpretation: After the user corrected x14 to A15 B7 A16 B6, the provisional signed crossing rule gives the oriented drawing linking matrix recorded here. The homology-label matrix is retained separately; the sign difference in A-B is an orientation/convention reconciliation issue, not a raw crossing-table failure.
sanity_observation.next_review_focus: Expand the A15 +1 full twist into explicit self-crossings before producing an evaluator-ready PD/local-piece input.
